title: Fantasy Player News
description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Patrick Mahomes II (elbow) logs full practice Wednesday
items.desc: Patrick Mahomes II was a full participant in practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Mahomes remains on track to be a full-go for Sunday's game against the Falcons.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Tyjae Spears (knee) misses practice Wednesday
items.desc: Tyjae Spears (knee) missed practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Spears was unable to practice on Wednesday. He has been dealing with this knee issue for a while, and it looks like the team's bye week wasn't enough to get him fully healthy. He's at risk of missing another game this week, which would lead to more work for Tony Pollard in Tennessee's backfield.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: DeMarvion Overshown (hamstring/back) limited Wednesday
items.desc: DeMarvion Overshown (hamstring/back) was limited at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Overshown was able to practice in a limited capacity on Wednesday. He missed last week's game due to a pair of issues, but he seems to be recovering well and may be back in Week 10. Dallas' defense will see a nice boost whenever he's back and fully healthy.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: KaVontae Turpin (ribs) limited at practice Wednesday
items.desc: KaVontae Turpin (ribs) was limited at Dallas' practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Turpin was able to log a limited practice session on Wednesday, despite having an injury to his ribs that he's dealing with at the moment. If he's able to play in Week 10, he will see more work in the event that George Pickens (hamstring) is unable to suit up for the Cowboys.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Trent McDuffie (back) not practicing Wednesday
items.desc: Trent McDuffie will not return to practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Rams coach Sean McVay said the team remains hopeful McDuffie can return on Sunday against the Cardinals.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jonathan Mingo (ankle) sidelined at practice Wednesday
items.desc: Jonathan Mingo (ankle) was sidelined at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Mingo suffered an ankle injury during Sunday's win over the Colts. He didn't practice on Wednesday because of it, and it seems likely to leave him sidelined in Week 10, though we won't know for sure until later in the week. He will see a lot less opportunities whenever George Pickens (hamstring) is back in the lineup as well.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jake Ferguson (knee/ankle) absent from practice Wednesday
items.desc: Jake Ferguson (knee/ankle) was absent from practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: As expected, Ferguson was not able to practice on Wednesday after suffering a couple of lower body injuries in Week 9's win over the Colts. He will almost certainly be out this week because of that, which will leave Brevyn Spann-Ford with more work than usual against the 49ers.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Travis Etienne Jr. (hamstring) returns to practice Wednesday
items.desc: Travis Etienne Jr. had his practice window opened on Wednesday.
items.impact: Etienne has been on injured reserve with a hamstring injury. He will have 21 days to be activated.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Joey Porter Jr. (ankle) misses practice Wednesday
items.desc: Joey Porter Jr. (ankle) missed Pittsburgh's practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: It was previously reported that the veteran was expected to practice on Wednesday, but he didn't end up taking part and was officially a non-participant. It remains to be seen if he will play in Week 10, and Dallas' secondary will be considerably worse if he has to sit out for another week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: George Pickens (hamstring) limited at practice Wednesday
items.desc: George Pickens (hamstring) was limited at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Pickens has missed some time recently due to a hamstring issue, but he was able to practice in a limited fashion on Wednesday, so it seems like his health is improving considerably. It remains to be seen if he will be ready to make his return to the lineup in Week 10, however, so fantasy managers should continue to closely monitor his status over the course of the practice week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Mike Evans (Achilles) considered week-to-week
items.desc: Mike Evans (Achilles) is considered week-to-week at this point.
items.impact: Evans is still recovering from an Achilles injury, and the team has no concrete timetable for his return beyond considering him week-to-week at this point. That makes him unlikely to play in Week 10, which would lead to more fantasy value for Deebo Samuel Sr. (hamstring) and Keenan Allen for the time being.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Puka Nacua (knee/toe) won't land on IR, still out for extended time
items.desc: Puka Nacua (knee/toe) will not land on injured reserve due to roster logistics, but he is still expected to be sidelined for around 4-6 weeks
items.impact: The Rams are not going to place Nacua on injured reserve, not because he will be back sooner than expected, but rather just as a roster management tactic. This is significant for fantasy managers, as he may not be eligible for an IR slot in many league formats as a result of this. That will make him significantly harder to roster for the 4-6 weeks that he's expected to be out.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Renardo Green (back) will miss practice Wednesday
items.desc: Renardo Green (back) will miss San Francisco's practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: A back issue will leave Green sidelined at practice on Wednesday. It's not expected to be a serious issue, but there's an off-chance that it will leave him sidelined in Week 10, which would be less than ideal for San Francisco's secondary this week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Deebo Samuel Sr. (hamstring) expected to be limited Wednesday
items.desc: Deebo Samuel Sr. (hamstring) is expected to return to practice in a limited fashion on Wednesday.
items.impact: Samuel has been out for a while due to a nagging hamstring issue, but he is going to return to practice on Wednesday and is expected to be a limited participant. He will have a chance to play in Week 10, but we won't know his status for sure until later on in the week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Deommodore Lenoir (foot) not practicing Wednesday
items.desc: Deommodore Lenoir (foot) is not taking part in San Francisco's practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Lenoir recently suffered a foot issue of some kind and won't be practicing on Wednesday as a result. He's considered day-to-day right now, so it looks more likely than not that he will be available to play in Week 10.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Gardner Minshew II (elbow) officially out for the season
items.desc: Gardner Minshew II (elbow) will officially miss the remainder of the season after undergoing a procedure on his elbow.
items.impact: HC Mike LaFleur confirmed that the veteran is going to miss the remainder of the season after undergoing a procedure to repair his elbow ligament. This comes as no surprise, but it is still less than ideal for this offense moving forward, especially with Carson Beck now confirmed to be their starter for the foreseeable future.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Carson Beck officially named starter for Week 10
items.desc: Carson Beck has officially been named the starter for Week 10's matchup against the Los Angeles Rams.
items.impact: HC Mike LaFleur confirmed that Gardner Minshew (elbow) is going to be out for the season and officially announced that Beck was going to start in his place in Week 10. This was expected coming into the week, and it will add a further degree of uncertainty to this offense moving forward, which is less than ideal for the fantasy value of Trey McBride and Tyler Allgeier.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Devin Moore has practice window opened by Cowboys
items.desc: The Cowboys opened the 21-day practice window for CB Devin Moore.
items.impact: Moore will have the next few weeks to officially be activated.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Blake Cashman placed in concussion protocol
items.desc: Vikings HC Kevin O'Connell said LB Blake Cashman was placed in the concussion protocol.
items.impact: Cashman is uncertain heading into Sunday on a short week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Kyler Murray (hamstring) remains week-to-week
items.desc: Vikings coach Kevin O'Connell said Kyler Murray remains week to week.
items.impact: Murray will figure to backup Kirk Cousins when he is healthy.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Derrick Harmon (foot) to ramp up in practice Wednesday
items.desc: Derrick Harmon will start to ramp up in practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Harmon will have a chance to play on Sunday against the Bengals.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jonathon Brooks (core) has practice window opened
items.desc: The Panthers opened the practice window of RB Jonathon Brooks.
items.impact: Brooks will have 21 days to officially be activated.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Harrison Mevis works out for Ravens
items.desc: The Ravens worked out free agent kicker Harrison Mevis.
items.impact: Mevis was released by the Rams. He will compete for the opportunity to kick for Baltimore.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Riley Patterson works out for Ravens
items.desc: The Ravens worked out free agent kicker Riley Patterson.
items.impact: Patterson was released by the Dolphins. He will compete for the opportunity to kick for Baltimore.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Will Lee III (hamstring) practicing Wednesday
items.desc: Will Lee III is practicing on Wednesday.
items.impact: Lee is on track to have a chance to play this week for the Panthers.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Damien Lewis (knee) practicing Wednesday
items.desc: Damien Lewis is practicing on Wednesday.
items.impact: Lewis was sidelined last week for the Panthers. His presence in practice to begin the week is a positive sign for his return.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Skyy Moore (ankle) to practice this week
items.desc: Packers coach Matt LaFleur said he's hopeful Skyy Moore will practice this week.
items.impact: Moore has missed the last four with an ankle injury.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Zaire Franklin (shin) hopeful to practice this week
items.desc: Packers coach Matt LaFleur said he's hopeful Zaire Franklin will practice this week.
items.impact: Franklin has missed the last three games with a shin injury.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Micah Parsons not practicing Wednesday due to illness
items.desc: Packers coach Matt LaFleur said Micah Parsons will not practice on Wednesday due to an illness.
items.impact: Parsons will be hopeful to return to practice on Thursday. He had his practice window opened last week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Sean Rhyan (ankle) could return in Week 10
items.desc: Packers coach Matt LaFleur said there is a chance that center Sean Rhyan could return this week.
items.impact: Rhyan was expected to avoid injured reserve. He will need to be monitored in practice the rest of the week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Cade Mays (ankle) uncertain for Week 10
items.desc: Cade Mays has an "outside shot of playing this week."
items.impact: Mays continues to battle an ankle injury. It appears he is trending the wrong direction this week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: D.J. Reed Jr. (hip) uncertain for Week 10
items.desc: D.J. Reed Jr. has an "outside shot of playing this week."
items.impact: Reed continues to battle a hip injury. It appears he is trending the wrong direction this week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: DJ Wonnum (concussion) to practice Wednesday
items.desc: DJ Wonnum will return to practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Wonnum has cleared an obstacle to return to action. He remains in concussion protocol.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Peter Woods (neck stinger) not practicing Wednesday
items.desc: Chiefs head coach Andy Reid said Peter Woods will not practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Woods remains day-to-day with a neck stinger.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jaylon Moore (ankle) will not practice Wednesday
items.desc: Chiefs head coach Andy Reid said Jaylon Moore will not practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Moore was considered day-to-day to begin the week. He'll need to be monitored in practice on Thursday and Friday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Xavier Worthy (hamstring) expected to practice Wednesday
items.desc: Chiefs head coach Andy Reid said he expects Xavier Worthy to practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Reid added that Worthy was "feeling pretty good" as he battles a hamstring injury.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Josh Jacobs (finger) could return in 2-to-3 weeks
items.desc: Packers RB Josh Jacobs could return in 2-to-3 weeks.
items.impact: Jacobs will have surgery later this week on his broken ring finger. The Packers will decide on Saturday if an IR stint is necessary.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Treylon Burks (foot) 'in good shape' to play Thursday
items.desc: Commanders coach Dan Quinn said Trey Burks is in good shape to play against the Giants on Thursday.
items.impact: Burks did not play last week for Washington. He'll need to be monitored in practice on Wednesday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Harrison Butker to remain Chiefs kicker in Week 10
items.desc: Harrison Butker will remain the Chiefs kicker in Week 10 against the Falcons.
items.impact: Butker continues to struggle on the season with another missed field goal.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jaylinn Hawkins (knee) practices Wednesday
items.desc: Jaylinn Hawkins practiced on Wednesday.
items.impact: Hawkins is back on the field after a mini bye for Baltimore. He did not play last Thursday for the Ravens.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Kyle Hamilton (hip) practices Wednesday
items.desc: Kyle Hamilton practiced on Wednesday.
items.impact: Hamilton was on the practice field off the mini bye for Baltimore. He'll have an extra day to practice with the Ravens playing on Monday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Michael Burton (calf) not practicing Wednesday
items.desc: Michael Burton did not practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Burton is battling a calf injury to start the week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Elgton Jenkins (knee) misses practice Wednesday
items.desc: Elgton Jenkins did not practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Jenkins continues to battle a knee injury. His status will need to be monitored in practice the rest of the week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Ronnie Hickman Jr. (concussion) misses practice Wednesday
items.desc: Ronnie Hickman Jr. did not practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Hickman will have till Saturday to clear concussion protocol.
